script: Spread and total were not saved for DET at ARI, so this script is form-only. The Detroit Lions' last three games are Jahmyr Gibbs-centered (51 carries, 197 rush yards; 23 targets, 148 receiving yards) with Jared Goff at 0.34 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=57) and 0.19 with no blitz. The Arizona Cardinals have given Jeremy Love 44 carries for 182 yards while Jacoby Brissett is -0.39 EPA vs blitz (n=49) and +0.13 without. Detroit blitzes 31% and Arizona only 23%, so the inferred DET@ARI script is the Lions throwing into a soft Cardinals pass defense (9.36/8.74/9.10 YPA left/middle/right) while Arizona's cleaner path is Love on the ground against a Lions run defense allowing 4.72 YPC and 16 runs of 10-plus.
who_goes_off: For the Arizona Cardinals, Jeremy Love should go off: 44 carries and 182 yards over weeks 2-4 into the Detroit Lions' 4.72 YPC run defense. Trey McBride (33 targets, 147 yards) is the ARI pass-catcher who maps to Detroit's middle, but 84.5 is 35 yards above his 49-yard pace. For the Detroit Lions, Amon-Ra St. Brown (32 targets, 236 yards) and Sam LaPorta (24 targets, 180 yards) are the volume options, while Isaac TeSlaa's 187 yards on 16 targets does not match a 25.5 DET receiving line.
weak_spot: The Detroit Lions' real leak is the middle: 11.52 YPA on 33 attempts versus 5.60 left (55 att) and 8.16 right (76 att), so the ARI matchup is LBs, nickel, and safeties, not outside corners. Detroit has also allowed 16 runs of 10-plus and 4.72 YPC. The Arizona Cardinals have no strong side — left 9.36 (39 att), middle 8.74 (31), right 9.10 (39) — and have allowed 14 passes of 20-plus on 118 attempts.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for DET@ARI, so fallout is usage-only. Arizona Cardinals carries: Jeremy Love 44, Tyler Allgeier 15, Jacoby Brissett 9. Detroit Lions carries: Jahmyr Gibbs 51, Sione Vaki 7, Jared Goff 5. Arizona targets: Michael Wilson 37, Trey McBride 33. Detroit targets: Amon-Ra St. Brown 32, Sam LaPorta 24, Jahmyr Gibbs 23, Isaac TeSlaa 16, Jameson Williams 16.
qb_vs_blitz: Detroit's Jared Goff is better when blitzed (0.34 EPA vs 0.19), but the Arizona Cardinals blitz only 23%, so most Goff dropbacks should be the lower split. Arizona's Jacoby Brissett is the mismatch: -0.39 EPA vs blitz on 49 dropbacks against +0.13 with no blitz, and the Detroit Lions pressure on 31% of dropbacks. That should stall the Cardinals' air game (Michael Wilson 335 air yards) and keep ARI carries with Jeremy Love.

picks.why: Detroit Lions WR Isaac TeSlaa has 16 targets, 187 receiving yards, and 215 air yards over the last three games, a 62.3-yard pace against a 25.5 line. The Arizona Cardinals have allowed 9.36, 8.74, and 9.10 YPA left/middle/right and 14 gains of 20-plus on 118 attempts, so that DET downfield slice is not running into a blanket.

Arizona Cardinals RB Jeremy Love has 44 carries and 182 yards over three games (60.7 per game) into a Detroit Lions defense allowing 4.72 YPC and 16 runs of 10-plus. Brissett's -0.39 EPA vs Detroit's 31% blitz rate should keep ARI on the ground. 45.5 sits 15 yards under that pace; Tyler Allgeier is only 15 carries and 51 yards in the same ARI sample.
